Boletus Luridus.



B. nigrescens. N. O. Fungi. Trituration.



Clinical. ─   Urticaria tuberosa.



Characteristics. ─   Poisoning effects show delirium;
        sunken features; violet colour of nose and lips; intense thirst; violent pain in
        epigastrium; meteorism; subsultus tendinum; urticaria tuberosa (speedily followed by death);
        cold sweat.
